services.name: 23’ Pontoon
services.desc: All pontoon rentals include basic life jackets for boat capacity, boarding ladder, Garmin lake map/depth finder, canopy top, and radio with Bluetooth capability. Pontoon shown in photo is a part of our current fleet. Lily pad not included in rental pricing but can be added. Click here for accessory pricing. NOTE: Our boats are docked on Gull Lake, cost below is for Gull Lake rentals. Tax is not included. We DO transport to other lakes in the Brainerd Lakes Area for a fee. Transport fee starts at $250 and increases based on lake distance, with the exception of North Long and Round Lakes. Both North Long and Round have FREE transportation with a 3+ day rental. Spend a day with friends on one
